thread:
maria: Need to lock webinar topic by EOD Fri. Top options: 1) \"Serving LLMs at 50ms\" (latency story) 2) \"Cost vs Quality: inference playbook\" (benchmarks + configs) 3) \"Hybrid: Hosted + Private for regulated apps\". Which one moves pipeline+leads best?

aj: 2 and 3 feel complementary. 2 is highest CTR for existing lists; 3 is good for enterprise pipeline.

sam_k: +1 on 2 for demand gen. We can surface cost benchmarks from Redwood Optimize — small table + demo.

elaine: If we pick 2, speaker roster: Maria (product), Sam (benchmarks), Ryan (customer case). Need a fourth moderator/host to keep cadence — Aj?

aj: I can moderate but can we shorten speaker slate to 3x10m talks + 15m panel + 15m Q&A? Keeps it punchy.

ryan: Customer is 👍 for a short case study, can do 5–7min highlights and submit a slide deck. Need speaker brief by Wed.

maria: Good. Draft abstract ideas — please react with :thumbsup: to the one you prefer. I pushed three one-liners below.

maria: 1) \"Cut inference unit costs without sacrificing quality: real benchmarks and configuration recipes from production\"

maria: 2) \"Practical inference: how teams shave latency and cost with batching, KV caching, and quantization\"

maria: 3) \"From PoC to production: routing, fallbacks, and SLOs that keep LLM features online\"

sam_k: :thumbsup: on 1. It's very actionable.

aj: Leaning 2 but 1 works if we call out playbooks & concrete numbers.

elaine: 1 gets my vote — aligns with benchmarks we already have.

ryan: 1 for me too.

maria: OK votes stacked for 1. Next: rehearsal + run-of-show draft. Can ops confirm greenroom slots and recording? @ops-bot schedule?

ops-bot: Recording slot held for 2026-04-14 10:00-11:30 PT. Greenroom 09:30-10:00 PT. Reply \"confirm\" to finalize.

aj: Confirm.

sam_k: Confirmed.

elaine: Confirmed.

ryan: Confirmed — will upload customer slides by 4/10.

maria: Run-of-show proposal (30m total):
```
09:50-10:00 join/greenroom check
10:00-10:02 host intro
10:02-10:12 Maria: benchmark highlights + TL;DR (10m)
10:12-10:22 Sam: configuration playbook + demo snippets (10m)
10:22-10:27 Ryan: customer case (5m)
10:27-10:35 Panel Q&A (8m)
10:35-10:40 Closing + CTA (5m)
```

maria: Notes: want to keep demo tiny and pre-record fallback. Sam — can you prepare a 60s recorded demo of the benchmarking dashboard and a short clip showing config change impact?

sam_k: Yep. Will provide two clips: 60s dashboard, 30s config-before-after. Uploads by 4/12.

elaine: I'll own speaker one-pagers + elevator pitch bullets for ops and hosts. Deliverable by 4/9.

aj: I'll draft the host script/opening lines and 3 crowd-engagement questions. 1st pass by Tue.

ryan: Customer legal asks if we can anonymize some numbers — I'll scrub before upload.

maria: Good call. Ops: can we add a failover note to the runbook — in case the live demo fails, we drop the pre-record and cut to panel 1min early?

ops-bot: Added failover: if demo latency > 10s or token errors appear, switch to pre-record clip and alert host. Panic channel: #release-war-room.

maria: Final asks: everyone add 3 bullet takeaways for shareable social post (2 lines) and 1 suggested tweet. We'll use that for launch copy. Due EOD Thu.

ryan: Adding deliverables to my calendar.

sam_k: Will add one-pager for the demo and share clip links to the thread when uploaded.

maria: Awesome. Thanks team — this is moving fast. If no objections by EOD Fri we'll lock topic and start promo cadence next week. :rocket:
